relation.note: Father, Shams al-Aʾimma (al-Sarāʾī). Corrects Gemini's poisoned TMP-P-000087 (= Ibn Fahd / AIND-D09211).

Ibn ʿArabshāh (= AIND-D01367) met the subject in Khwārazm and took (knowledge) from him (فأخذ عنه); the subject is therefore the teacher and Ibn ʿArabshāh the pupil. Corrects Gemini's bogus student-relation to poisoned TMP-P-000066 and the direction, and resolves Ibn ʿArabshāh from poisoned TMP-P-000127 (= Ibn Fahd / AIND-D09211) to AIND-D01367.

event.desc: قال ابن عربشاه إنه كان يقال له ملك الكلام الفارسي والتركي والعربي

person.note: アフマド・ブン・シャムス・アル=アインマ・アッ=サラーイー・アル=ワーイズ（説教師）。イブン・アラブシャーがホラズムで彼に会い、彼から（知識を）学んだ。そしてイブン・アラブシャーは、彼が「ペルシア語・トルコ語・アラビア語の言葉の王」と呼ばれていたと述べた。

Aḥmad b. Shams al-Aʾimma al-Sarāʾī al-Wāʿiẓ (the Preacher). Ibn ʿArabshāh met him in Khwārazm and took (knowledge) from him, and said that he was called the 'King of Persian, Turkish, and Arabic speech'.
